findings.location: AD-1 and R-2; pass1-api.md Start contract; spec.md Edge Cases concurrency-change case
findings.affected_requirement: FR-006; User Story 1 acceptance scenario 3; concurrency-setting edge case
findings.evidence: The accepted specification explicitly requires that when the shared concurrency setting changes while jobs are leased, existing leases remain valid and new claims obey the effective persisted setting. The plan instead stores concurrency at atomic start, makes a changed concurrency on replay a conflict, and defines no authorized update command, API, version-conditional transition, or test seam. The proposed implementation therefore cannot exercise the stated edge case and can only keep the original value or reject the change.
findings.correction_outcome: Define one bounded authorized version-conditional way to change an active pair's concurrency among 1-4, including validation, ownership, replay/conflict semantics, pair-row locking, treatment of already-valid leases when the limit decreases, claim behavior for the next lease, API or internal command exposure, durable audit fields, and public-seam tests. Keep concurrency excluded from job, Document, reconciliation, and display identity.

findings.location: communicationEvidence at lines 300-327; code-logic-projection-contract.md semantic validation lines 17-18
findings.evidence: communicationEvidence.communicationKind is arbitrary boundedText. Semantic validation requires referenced classification IDs to be supplied, but does not require communicationKind to be a canonical Story 12.2 kind or to equal the kind of every referenced classification. A schema-valid Worker result can therefore label an HTTP or Hint classification as a different communication kind and commit/project unsupported communication evidence, even though Story 12.2 classifications are authoritative and Story 12.3 must not infer endpoint/provider ownership.
findings.correction_outcome: Close communicationKind to the accepted canonical Communication Kind vocabulary and specify exact semantic consistency between the authored kind, each referenced classification, its strength/catalog rule identity/evidence locator, and any navigation-derived evidence. Mixed or mismatched kinds must reject before projection/commit with zero Document rows. Add single-field mutation tests for kind, strength, classification ID, catalog identity, and evidence locator while retaining Story 12.2 meaning unchanged.

findings.location: deferredObservation at lines 353-387; navigate-code-contract.md Bounds and Durable receipt sections
findings.affected_requirement: User Story 2 acceptance scenarios 4 and 6; FR-016; FR-028
findings.evidence: The specification permits a Worker to record a structured deferred observation when call, result, byte, or depth bounds are exhausted. The navigation contract returns BoundExceeded with no evidence and explicitly writes no receipt, but every deferredObservation requires at least one navigationReceiptId. A first over-depth request or an over-byte/result response with no earlier relevant accepted call can therefore satisfy the bounded tool outcome but cannot produce a schema-valid deferred observation, making the required truthful fallback unrepresentable.
findings.correction_outcome: Define a deterministic bounded proof for refused/exhausted navigation that can be referenced without releasing evidence, either by persisting a metadata-only refusal receipt outside accepted evidence counters or by allowing an exact server-verifiable bound-attempt reference in deferred observations. Specify identity, budget accounting, replay, revalidation, no-information-leakage, and canonical projection behavior for every call/result/byte/depth exhaustion case, then add zero/prior-receipt and first-request vectors.

summary: REVISE. The plan otherwise preserves the August Windows-host architecture, pinned CodeGraph/Java/JDT-LS identities, PostgreSQL-only Docker dependency, no-CodeGraphContext boundary, exactly-two-manifest atomic start, accepted Story 12.1 job/replay contracts, accepted Story 12.2 manifest/hash/order contracts, strict authoritative code-logic/file-v2 projection model, pair-wide provider circuit, one isolated retry, honest seed/failure budget, immutable Documents, deterministic same-Repository reconciliation, and Story 12.4/12.5 exclusions. Coverage inspection accounted for all 56 Functional Requirements, 12 Success Criteria, and 28 acceptance scenarios, but three High plan-owned contradictions prevent ACCEPT: active concurrency reconfiguration has no implementation seam, communication kind can diverge from authoritative classifications, and BoundExceeded deferred observations can be impossible to represent. The nonrecursive boundary identity is SHA-256 over sorted path-tab-file-SHA256 lines for the 16 owned raw artifacts. Read-only checks used full skill/authority/artifact reads, line-bounded inspections, repository-wide rg searches, source/test feasibility inspection, Git identity/status observation, and SHA-256 hashing. No reviewed artifact, lifecycle state, index, branch, commit, or history was changed; only this raw verdict file was created.
